metadata.name: Fruit & Vegetable Intake

sources.citation: Wang X, Ouyang Y, Liu J, Zhu M, Zhao G, Bao W, Hu FB. Fruit and vegetable consumption and mortality from all causes, cardiovascular disease, and cancer: systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies. BMJ. 2014;349:g4490

metadata.description: All-cause mortality HR 0.95 (95% CI 0.92-0.98) per daily serving of fruit+vegetables, with a plateau at ~5 servings/day. Curve renormalized so typical US intake (~1.5 vegetable servings/day) is the reference (HR 1) — below-typical intake reads as elevated risk, not zero effect. Overlaps slightly with the diabetes model's diet-quality factor (diabetes CFR 0.03, negligible).
